reviews.title: Love the game
reviews.text: I honestly love the game, in my opinion it’s better than BitLife and I have been that game since it came out, there are a few issues that I have with the game. For example when your character dies and they had any type of asset (cars,weapons,BUSINESS,etc) they lose it when the new character is receiving the past characters will. Also for the HealthCare, when you try and diagnose and cure certain things(high blood pressure, dementia) it doesn’t allow you to. Another thing is with the business, when it says “help needed” it doesn’t specify how many employees you need. In my opinion there should be some type of selector that allows you to employ as many employees as you want instead of doing 4 each click. Those are just some of the issues that bother me a lil bit but besides that, it’s an incredible game that definitely has potential to be bigger than any other Life Situation out there!!!!
